title: Kept code units
description: <config root>/observational-memory/memories/code/<project key>/units.json (project key: first 16 hex of sha256 of the clean absolute project root): the Go declarations the memory tool kept, sorted by name, written indented through a temporary file and a rename. A file that is not an array of units loads nothing and blocks writes until repaired; a unit whose digest does not match its source is refused at load. Source: memory/codestore/store.go (Unit, read, write, Dir, ProjectKey, Digest).
